netstat-anv-macos26.txt.format: one netstat output; a row subset kept, header lines byte-exact

netstat-anv-reference-host-idle.txt.host_role: reference host running the messaging gateway, idle
netstat-anv-reference-host-idle.txt.format: six netstat outputs 15 s apart; each begins with a line '=== SAMPLE <n> observed_at=<UTC ISO> observed_uptime_ms=<ms since boot>'; header lines byte-exact

sanitization: Only the Local Address and Foreign Address tokens were rewritten; every other byte of each kept row is as captured.
Messaging-service IPv4 addresses map to 203.0.113.0/24, other remote IPv4 to 198.51.100.0/24, local, private, loopback and CGNAT IPv4 to 192.0.2.0/24 (never .254).

IPv6: macOS netstat truncates IPv6 host text to at most 16 characters and drops the zone. A truncated host is replaced by an equal-length, equally unparsable stand-in under 2001:db8. No captured IPv6 host text was complete.
Rows of other processes were reduced to a neutral subset (system daemons, a browser helper, node, a messaging client, an empty process name, a process name with a space).
absent: No macOS 15 host was available; the accepted header set is the single macOS 26 header both files share.
